gossfile.description: Path to the Goss test file to read from or write to.

log_level.description: Goss log verbosity level (e.g., INFO, DEBUG, WARN, ERROR).

package.description: Package manager type to assume for package-related tests: apk, dpkg, pacman, or rpm.

vars.description: Path to a JSON/YAML file containing variables for gossfile template expansion.

vars_inline.description: Inline JSON/YAML string containing variables for gossfile template expansion (overrides vars file).
